Every stain, every tear-like detail, every mark across the white fabric feels like a reflection of pain, struggle, and the stories of people who have endured difficult moments. 💔 The beauty of this costume is not meant to be comfortable. It is meant to make us stop. To make us look. To make us feel. Behind the crown is a woman carrying the name of an entire nation. Behind the glamour is a story. And behind the costume is a message that says: Nepal may face difficult days, but Nepal will never stop standing. 🇳🇵❤️‍🩹 The red words “PRAY FOR NEPAL” feel like a scream in silence—a reminder that sometimes a national costume doesn’t need thousands of embellishments or a gigantic crown to make an impact.
